sketch:
Observe: schematic with a variable DC source, a resistor, and a diode
slot; student sweeps E from −5 V to +5 V and watches the live I(U)
characteristic populate — a knee near +0.6 V (seuil) emerges, current
stays ~0 in reverse. Experiment: build a half-wave redresseur — swap
DC for AC source, add scope probes at input and output, observe the
truncated sinusoid. Evaluate: given a target output waveform
(half-wave / full-wave via bridge), student wires 1–4 diodes into the
correct bridge configuration. Wrinkle: LED variant with polarity
mistake fries the diode (small anim).
